note: PER-BLOCK LIBRARY — the box of legos, indexed one block at a time. Each entry is ONE distinct reusable block: its FIXED dimensions (px @1280×720, from cm×37.8), where it anchors, its internal content spec, and the leftover 'exit' slot it leaves. You BUILD by picking blocks from this list and dropping them into the content region (1240×588 @ x20,y84 — see canvas-frame.md), corner-anchored, NEVER stretched. Sizes are the real template sizes; text inside is 9.5pt (12.7px) except hero-KPI figures and the 14pt title.

blocks.content: Cash-flow composite. RIGHT column (~780px): TOP a hairline-bordered quarterly stacked-bar chart (FY21A, Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec) with a left legend (Other working capital / Trade payables / Trade receivables / Inventory in grey→yellow tints) and an overlaid gold 'Normalized NWC' line; BOTTOM a hairline-bordered notes panel with grey small-caps sub-headers (NET WORKING CAPITAL / CAPEX / OPERATIONAL FREE CASH FLOW) each over gold ▷ bullets. Footnote row beneath. All text 9.5pt.
blocks.exit: fills the full content region — left tables column + right chart-over-notes column
